findings.original_finding: Shot Distribution Vagueness - Missing formulas for Poisson/NB
findings.verification: CONFIRMED RESOLVED. Shot Distribution Methodology section (before 4.2.2 ShotProductionCalculator) provides complete mathematical specification. Step 1: μ = Σ(shots_per_match) / n, σ² = Σ((shots - μ)²) / (n-1). Step 2: Distribution selection with explicit condition 'if variance > mean: use Negative Binomial, else: use Poisson'. Step 3: NB parameterization: r = μ²/(σ² - μ), p = μ/σ² with validation 'if r <= 0 or p <= 0 or p >= 1: return None'. Poisson parameterization: λ = μ with validation 'if λ <= 0: return None'. Step 4: Threshold probability formulas P(X > T) = 1 - CDF_NB(T; r, p) and P(X > T) = 1 - CDF_Poisson(T; λ) with explicit CDF summations. Standard thresholds listed: 10+, 12+, 15+, 18+, 20+ for shots. Edge cases covered: mean=0, variance=0, variance=mean, variance<mean. Minimum sample size: MIN_MATCHES_WITH_SHOT_DATA = 3.
findings.evidence: Shot Distribution Methodology section (lines 585-750), Step 2 distribution selection (lines 602-607), Step 3 parameterization formulas (lines 609-632), Step 4 threshold calculation (lines 634-651), Step 6 minimum sample logic (lines 684-695), Step 7 edge cases (lines 697-717).

findings.original_finding: Lineup Impact Methodology - Avoid arbitrary percentages
findings.verification: CONFIRMED RESOLVED. Section 4.2.3 LineupIntelligenceCalculator.calculate_lineup_impact() includes comprehensive Statistical Methodology with 7 explicit steps. Step 1: Split matches into WITH player and WITHOUT player samples. Step 2: Calculate performance differential with formula 'impact = (performance_with_player - performance_without_player)' using goals/match, xG/match, points/match, xGA/match. Step 3: Validate sample sizes with 'if n_with < min_with_player or n_without < min_without_player: return None'. Step 4: Calculate confidence formula accounting for sample size and imbalance. Step 5: Aggregate multiple absences. Step 6: Context normalization for opponent strength, home/away, match importance. Step 7: Replacement player quality when available. Explicit prohibition: 'NO Arbitrary Percentages: ✗ Star player out = -15% attack, ✓ Calculate from historical with/without samples'. Missing data handling: 'If no historical lineup data → all impacts = None', 'Never use hardcoded penalty values'.
findings.evidence: Statistical Methodology section (lines 1065-1150), Step 2 formula (lines 1074-1081), Step 3 validation (lines 1083-1088), Step 4 confidence formula (lines 1090-1098), NO Arbitrary Percentages note (lines 1116-1118), Missing Data Handling (lines 1136-1142).

findings.original_finding: Common Opponent Confidence - Missing explicit formula
findings.verification: CONFIRMED RESOLVED. Section 5.2.1 CommonOpponentCalculator.find_common_opponents() includes Common Opponent Confidence Calculation with complete mathematical specification. Formula: 'confidence = (sample_factor) * (recency_factor) * (context_factor)' where sample_factor = min(1.0, n_common_opponents / 5), recency_factor = avg_match_recency_weight, context_factor = home_away_match_rate. Statistical Evidence Threshold defined with get_signal() function requiring BOTH |differential| >= 0.3 AND confidence >= 0.5 for non-neutral signal. Risk classification explicitly stated as MEDIUM RISK. Implementation includes _calculate_confidence() method with explicit formula. Never claim superiority requirements: n >= min_common_opponents, confidence >= 0.5, |differential| >= 0.3.

summary: All 14 findings (4 HIGH, 8 MEDIUM, 2 LOW) from the original review have been RESOLVED in design v2.0. The revised design provides: (1) Complete data contracts using MatchWithStatistics matching actual repository models, (2) Comprehensive DATA AVAILABILITY MATRIX documenting available vs unavailable metrics with explicit UNAVAILABLE markings, (3) Historical opponent strength reconstruction using existing Elo system with temporal validity enforcement, (4) Complete shot distribution methodology with explicit Poisson/Negative Binomial formulas including distribution selection, parameterization, CDF calculations, and edge cases, (5) Manager change data availability documented as statistical detection (available) vs external events (future), (6) Shot location marked UNAVAILABLE until coordinates exist, (7) Lineup impact methodology with statistical with/without sampling and explicit prohibition of arbitrary percentages, (8) Common opponent confidence formula with sample/recency/context factors and statistical evidence thresholds, (9) Feature versioning convention with semantic versioning and increment rules, (10) Walk-forward temporal enforcement listing all 7 calculators with before_datetime requirements, (11) Interaction features with explicit operations (multiply/divide/ratio/difference) and concrete candidate examples, (12) Feature provenance metadata structure with temporal validation. All mathematical methodologies are complete and unambiguous. All unavailable data explicitly documented with None returns (never fabricated). All temporal validity mechanisms enforceable through before_datetime parameters. Design matches actual repository structure and preserves existing 7-model architecture. Ready for implementation.

data_limitations: Tactical metrics (PPDA, Field Tilt, progressive passes) require future provider - correctly handled as UNAVAILABLE
Shot coordinates unavailable - correctly handled with None returns
Manager changes limited to statistical detection initially - correctly documented with detected_by field
Interaction features disabled until GROUP 6 validation - correct cautious approach
implementation_risks: Baseline comparison (GROUP 6) must validate advanced features improve predictions before production
Opponent-adjusted features may be redundant with Elo - backtesting will determine
Common opponent features are MEDIUM risk - confidence thresholds must be validated empirically
Shot distribution model selection (Poisson vs NB) requires sufficient sample size
validation_requirements: GROUP 6 walk-forward backtesting critical - must demonstrate improvement over baseline
Temporal validity post-hoc validation - verify no leakage in practice
Feature contribution analysis (GROUP 7) - identify redundant features
Calibration validation for shot markets - ensure probabilities are well-calibrated

design_strengths: Complete mathematical specifications - no vague 'fit model' statements
Explicit data availability transparency - unavailable metrics clearly documented
Temporal validity throughout - all calculators enforce before_datetime
Statistical rigor - confidence formulas, sample size requirements, validation thresholds
Architecture preservation - extends existing pipeline without parallel systems
Provenance tracking - full metadata for reproducibility and debugging
Cautious production path - features validated through backtesting before activation
No fabrication - explicit None returns when data unavailable
Comprehensive testing strategy - unit, integration, regression tests per group
